name: Setsugetsu Shou
source:
That day when I left the girl I cared about in my hometown, I set out for the city and traveled.
In our hometown, she kept waiting for me, but I was so stupid and seduced by the colors of the city that we gradually lost contact.

A golden moon in the night when I can't sleep, a thin white moon in the morning...
What's really important, I'm pitiful, I look at the night sky alone
